title: PERMA-guided multi-topology graph neural networks for cross-cultural student well-being prediction
reason: Well-being prediction model (GNN-Transformer) trained on two Kaggle survey datasets. All features are questionnaire self-report; authors state no LMS behavioural logs were used. No LMS indicator or activity product related to success or a construct.

extraction.country: Western online survey respondents; Japan (international university)
extraction.population: Lifestyle and Wellbeing Data (work-life balance survey respondents, n = 12,757) and 268 students at an international university in Japan
extraction.notes: Authors: 'existing features rely primarily on survey questionnaires and self-reported data, lacking integration of objective indicators such as behavioral logs from learning management systems'. Secondary: E3 for the larger dataset (general-population survey, not students). Two datasets, so a single n is not given.
